scDblFinder doublet calls plus a contaminant-gene UCell score on the merged epithelial object.

Paths are relative to this `scripts/` directory.

# Load Required Libraries
```{r chunk-01}
# Set custom library path and load packages for doublet detection and gene-signature scoring
# portable: only prepend these library paths when they actually exist
for (.p in c("/Users/ikjot.sidhu/R/library")) if (dir.exists(.p)) .libPaths(c(.p, .libPaths()))
library(scDblFinder)
library(Seurat)
library(tidyverse)
library(UCell)
```

# Load Data and Convert to SingleCellExperiment
```{r chunk-02}
# Read in the processed epithelial Seurat object (immune cells removed)
seu <- readRDS("../../04-merge-controls/outputs/epithelia_EP.CTRL_data.processed(no-immune).RDS")

# Create a v3 assay from the current default assay (e.g., "RNA")
# Required because scDblFinder works with the older Assay class
seu[["RNA_v3"]] <- as(seu[["RNA"]], Class = "Assay")

# Set the new v3 assay as the default for the conversion step
DefaultAssay(seu) <- "RNA_v3"

# Convert to SingleCellExperiment object for use with scDblFinder
sce <- as.SingleCellExperiment(seu, assay = "RNA_v3")
```

# Run scDblFinder Doublet Detection
```{r chunk-03}
# Detect doublets per sample; the 'samples' argument ensures detection is run within each sample independently
sce <- scDblFinder(sce, samples="orig.ident")
```

# Transfer Doublet Results Back to Seurat Object
```{r chunk-04}
# Get results from SCE object
dbl_scores <- sce$scDblFinder.score
dbl_class <- sce$scDblFinder.class

# Add doublet score and singlet/doublet classification to Seurat object metadata
seu <- AddMetaData(object = seu, metadata = dbl_scores, col.name = "scDblFinder_score")
seu <- AddMetaData(object = seu, metadata = dbl_class, col.name = "scDblFinder_class")
```

# Inspect Doublet Classification and Filter
```{r chunk-05}
# View the distribution of scores or classification counts
table(seu$scDblFinder_class)

# Visualize in a UMAP plot
DimPlot(seu, group.by = "scDblFinder_class")

# Filter out doublets for downstream analysis
seu_filtered <- subset(seu, subset = scDblFinder_class == "singlet")

```
# Plot Doublet Composition by Cell Type
```{r chunk-06}
# Summarise the proportion of singlets vs doublets within each cell-type label
composition.df <- table(seu@meta.data$cell_type_labels, seu@meta.data$scDblFinder_class) %>% as.data.frame() %>% dplyr::rename(cell_type_labels=Var1, scDblFinder_class=Var2) 

# Custom text styling for rotated x-axis labels
black.bold.16.text <- element_text(face = "bold", color = "black", size = 14,angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust=1)

# Y-axis percentage breakpoints
brks <- c(0, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 1)

# Stacked bar chart showing % singlet/doublet composition per cell type
#pdf(file="../outputs/PERCENTAGE_COMPOSTION_PLOT_GROUP_BY_LOCATION_EPITHELIA-ONLY.pdf",height = 14,width = 8)
ggplot(composition.df,aes(x=cell_type_labels,y=Freq,fill=scDblFinder_class)) + geom_bar(stat="identity", position="fill")  + ggplot2::theme(panel.grid.major = element_blank(), panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
panel.background = element_blank(), axis.text.x=black.bold.16.text) + scale_y_continuous(breaks = brks, labels = scales::percent(brks)) + ylab("% Composition of Location by Clusters")
#dev.off()
```
Use UCell to calculate gene signature score for possible contaminant genes 
```{r chunk-07}
# Define a list of B-cell / immune contaminant marker genes to score
contamin_genes <- list(Contaminant_genes=c("Ighg2b", "Iglv1", "Ighg3","Iglc2","Iglc3","Cd79a","Cd19", "Cd22","Ptprc"))
# Calculate a per-cell UCell module score for the contaminant gene signature
seu <- UCell::AddModuleScore_UCell(seu,features=contamin_genes)
```

# Visualise Contaminant Gene Scores by Doublet Classification
```{r chunk-08}
# Violin and dot plots to check whether doublets have higher contaminant gene expression
VlnPlot(seu,group.by = "scDblFinder_class",features = c("Contaminant_genes_UCell"))
DotPlot(seu,group.by = "scDblFinder_class",features = c("Contaminant_genes_UCell"))
```
